google_search_console.required_manual_action: The responsible owner must confirm which account should own the property, then add the URL-prefix property, issue the verification value, deploy it and confirm verification before submitting the sitemap.

bing_webmaster_tools.required_manual_action: An authenticated owner must add the site, issue the verification value, deploy it and confirm verification before submitting the sitemap.

limitations: Public HTTP availability does not prove provider ownership verification.
A reachable sitemap does not prove that a provider accepted or processed it.
No provider token, property identifier or authenticated state was invented.
